title: Bicol launches ‘Bring Your Own Bote’ drive to fight plastic waste

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The Department of Environment and Natural Resources in Bicol is promoting reusable bottles and containers to reduce plastic waste and advance sustainable waste management and a circular economy. The initiative was launched on Wednesday through the “Bring Your Own Bote” (BYOB) campaign during the 2026 Environment and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Summit in Naga City. Spearheaded by the DENR’s Environmental Management Bureau (EMB) in Bicol, in partnership with the Naga City government and food giant NutriAsia Inc., the summit brought together government officials, industry representatives, and environmental stakeholders to promote plastic waste reduction.
